text:
incident-bot: P1 - GPU capacity exhaustion detected in us-west-2. Autoscaler failing to add nodes for nodegroup 'gpu-pool-usw2'. Queue growth + increased 429 throttles. Paging oncall @alex :rotating_light:

alex: on it. grabbing logs and starting triage. which clusters?

maria: seeing spike on inference-1 (prod-usw2) - queue depth for gpu-models up 6x, p50 latency up from 120ms to 1.2s. Some requests are 429'ing.

jamal: I pulled cluster events, autoscaler logs show repeated errors: 
```
I0310 17:02:13.456123       1 scale_up.go:123] NodeGroup gpu-pool-usw2: scale up ignored: max size reached
E0310 17:02:13.456456       1 aws_manager.go:456] Failed to create instance: LaunchTemplateOverride: AccessDenied: You are not authorized to use the specified launch template
```

alex: interesting - two different failure modes: hit max size and launch template IAM error. Can someone grep for 'max size' across nodes?

irma: confirmed. ASG min=0 desired=8 max=8 for gpu-pool-usw2. Looks like we hit the max. Also found event on nodegroup controller: 
```
Warning  FailedCreate  2m (x10 over 15m)  node-controller  Failed to create node: taint "gpu:NoSchedule" is set on launch template but pod tolerations mismatch
```

sre: so all three: ASG at cap, LT IAM denying launch, and taint mismatch on new nodes. Which came first uncertain.

ops-bot: Customer-impact: 7 production routes degraded. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (high), Chalkline (medium). Auto-fallbacks kicked in for non-critical customers.

support-lead: Support notified enterprise customers with a brief note. We need an ETA or mitigation now.

alex: immediate mitigations we can try (short list):
- bump ASG max for gpu-pool-usw2 by +10 (fast)
- temporarily remove taint from launch template (if safe) or add toleration to pods (harder product-side)
- create ad-hoc GPU nodes via manual EC2 launch in same ASG (if LT blocked, use different LT)
- failover traffic to prod-usw1 where capacity exists

maria: failover to prod-usw1 will increase inter-region latency for some customers, but better than 429s. Do we have capacity in usw1?

jamal: yes small headroom in prod-usw1 (2-3 nodes) but not enough for full load. Combined with autoscaler we can shift some routes.

irma: IAM issue needs a fix in instance profile/launch template. Logs from launch service: 
```
ERROR: LaunchTemplate: launch_template_id=lt-0a1b2c denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-launch-role: Action "ec2:RunInstances" is not authorized for the specified resource
```

alex: ok root causes summarized: 1) ASG max reached, 2) launch template IAM policy missing permission to RunInstances or use a particular ENI config, 3) launch template includes a taint that pods don't tolerate. We'll do a two-track mitigation: quick capacity (ASG bump + temporary LT override) + traffic reroute + longer fix (IAM + taint alignment).

jamal: I'm going to bump ASG max to 18 now (+10). Will monitor scale activity.

alex: do it and post command.

jamal: running: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-usw2 --max-size 18`

ops-bot: autoscaling update requested.

maria: while that runs I'll prepare a kpt to add toleration to the inference pods for gpu:NoSchedule so they can land if nodes come up with that taint. This is lower risk than changing LT taints.

irma: on the IAM side I'll open a console case and also try a quick policy patch: add ec2:RunInstances to the role used by the launch template. holding for approval from infra.

alex: we should avoid touching prod LT without a rollback plan. If IAM fix will take >15m, consider launching nodes with different launch template that already works and add them to cluster (manual node join).

jamal: ASG scaling actions started: 4 instances launching. However I'm still seeing errors: 
```
InstanceLaunchFailure: Launch template override failed: launch template version not authorized
```

alex: that looks IAM-related still. Are the new instances failing to boot?

jamal: 2 of 4 failed, 2 pending. Failed ones show different error: ENI quota exceeded in subnet - need to pick different subnet. 

maria: subnet/ENI problem too? Now multi-factor. Let's pause and re-evaluate.

ops-bot: Customer impact update: latency spikes continue. Throttles still present for AcmeCorp. Escalation path: Consider routing AcmeCorp to Dedicated reserved pool (they have contract), fallback route configured?

support-lead: AcmeCorp agreed to temporary failover if we can provide 20-30m ETA. They want confirmation before we switch.

alex: Jamal - stop new launches to avoid more ENI failures. Scale down plan after we stabilize. For immediate relief I'll open a targeted routing rule to send AcmeCorp traffic to prod-usw1. Maria help me craft the config change.

maria: creating route rule: set route for customer_id:acmecorp -> cluster:prod-usw1, model:gpu-model-v2. Pushing now.

ops-bot: Route change pushed for 3 routes belonging to AcmeCorp.

support-lead: Confirming AcmeCorp has been routed. They report reduced errors but latency increased ~350ms. They acknowledged.

irma: IAM ticket: quick patch applied to role gpu-launch-role to allow RunInstances + CreateTags for the LT. Pending audit but should allow new launches.

jamal: re-triggering scaling for remaining required count but constrained by subnet ENI. I'm launching smaller set into alternate subnet that has spare IPs. 3 nodes coming up.

alex: good. Also Maria, finish the toleration rollout so pods can land if nodes still have the taint. Use canary on 10% of replicas.

maria: applying deployment patch: 
```
- name: tolerate-gpu
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
    tolerationSeconds: 300
```
Canary started.

jamal: new nodes are joining the cluster (3/3 ready). Pods scheduling onto new nodes. Queue depth dropping.

ops-bot: System metrics: queue depth for gpu-models back to 1.2x baseline. 429s reduced by 90% for affected routes.

sre: we should run a root-cause checklist:
- Why ASG max was set at 8 for gpu-pool-usw2? (productively expected baseline vs emergency buffer)
- Why launch template IAM lost RunInstances permission? (recent IAM changes?)
- Why taint present on launch template with pods lacking tolerations? (LT drift or chart mismatch)

alex: assign owners: infra (irma) for IAM + ASG policy review, runtime (maria) for pod tolerations and rollout, infra (jamal) for ASG/subnet capacity. Product to review capacity sizing and routing policy for heavy customers.

irma: filing followup tickets:
- IAM policy revert & audit (SEC-1234)
- ASG auto-ops: ensure buffer 20% headroom (OPS-4321)
- LaunchTemplate drift detection (OPS-4322)

support-lead: Customer comms: I'll send an update to impacted customers summarizing mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

alex: current state: new nodes up, traffic rerouted for critical customers, queue depth recovering. Marking incident as 'mitigated' but not 'resolved'. We'll continue to monitor for 1 hour, then schedule postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria: I'll run a stress sweep to verify autoscaler behaves when load returns.

jamal: I'll also open a runbook PR to include steps we used here (ASG bump, route failover, toleration canary).

alex: great. Thanks team. Final quick notes for the postmortem: timeline, root causes (ASG cap + IAM deny + taint mismatch + subnet ENI shortage), mitigations done, and action items with owners.

ops-bot: Participants logged: alex, maria, jamal, irma, sre, support-lead.

support-lead: I'll draft customer follow-up and postmortem notification. ETA 2 hours for draft.

alex: ending thread. If anything regresses ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
